sourceFile: 37.1 L20S15-07 Report test find reason NG hearing high 2024.04.08_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it misidentifies the comparison and extracts NG hearing results incorrectly.
issues: Changed factor wrongly treats Normal as baseline instead of likely VP condition with CD lot/date comparison.
Line and total groupings are mixed; C2, E2, and Total rows are not preserved.
NG Hearing totals are undercounted by using Noise only and ignoring Touch/Total NG in several rows.
Relevant total rows 30, 32, 34, and 36 are omitted from outcomes and evidence.
Measurement outcomes from title/header rows are spurious.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the primary comparison be CD lot/date while VP remains Normal?
Should NG Hearing use Total NG/NG Rate or separate Noise and Touch metrics?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor around CD lot/date or lot identifier with VP Normal as context.
Separate or subgroup results by Line C2, Line E2, and Total TEST E2+C2.
Use NG Hearing Noise, Touch, Total NG, and NG Rate columns correctly.
Include rows 14,16,18,20,22,24,26 and total rows 28,30,32,34,36 as applicable.
Remove bogus measurement outcomes derived from title/header rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are incomplete and tied to incorrect grouping, so not sufficient.
